title: Isolated offline differential harness protocol

included: Offline differential comparison of independently authored Rust against digest-bound target expectations
Fixture identities with explicit SHA-256 and declared side effects
Positive controls (known-equal windows) and negative/corruption controls
Plan-only tooling that validates a request without spawning the captured node or visor
excluded: Running captured hl-node or hl-visor without a present APPROVAL.md for that exact request
Live validator operation, mainnet or testnet traffic
Importing private keys or home-directory secrets

positive_controls.purpose: Known-equal reconstructed window matches digest-bound expectation under declared masks
Boundary fixture within accepted width/rounding family returns the documented result

negative_controls.purpose: Single-byte corruption of expectation or payload must fail the comparator
Fixture bound to a different target SHA-256 must be rejected
Request that omits or under-declares side effects must be rejected
Any plan that requests network access without approval must fail closed

acceptance_checklist: Protocol documents isolated offline differential comparison
No-network and side-effect controls are fail-closed by default
Fixture identities carry digest, payload hash, and declared effects
Positive and negative controls are named and testable
Execution of captured binaries requires APPROVAL.md for that request
Plan tool never spawns node or visor; design packet claims no reconstruction gate
limits: This packet is design and plan-only tooling. It does not run the target.
No component behavior or identity gate is requested.
Comparator implementation remains future work under RE-004+.
